meta.title: Pixel Drift
meta.tagline: Drift through neon skies. Chase the horizon.
meta.description: A retro-futuristic 2D racing game with platforming elements. Pilot customizable hover-bikes through procedurally generated neon cityscapes, floating islands, and underground tunnels. Drift, boost, and wall-ride your way to victory. Single-player campaign with 50 hand-crafted tracks plus infinite procedural mode.

skill_trees.name: Handling
skill_trees.description: Drift control, turning radius, air control.

skill_trees.name: Style
skill_trees.description: Trail effects, sound customization, victory animations.

currencies.name: Drift Coins
currencies.description: Earned by winning races and setting records.

custom_mechanics.name: Drift Boost Chain
custom_mechanics.description: Maintaining long drifts builds a boost meter. Chaining drifts without touching walls multiplies the boost. Perfect drifts through corners give bonus speed.
rules: Each second of drift fills 10% of boost meter
Perfect drift (no wall contact, tight line) = instant 25% meter fill
Boost can be stored and released strategically
interactions: Boost pads on tracks stack with drift boost
Some shortcuts require a maxed boost to reach
Time trials reward perfect drift chains with ghost unlock

environments.name: Neon District
environments.visual_description: A sprawling cyberpunk cityscape of towering neon signs, holographic billboards, and rain-slicked streets. Tracks wind through skyscraper canyons, over rooftop highways, and through underground parking structures. Everything glows in hot pink, electric blue, and acid green. Color palette: black, hot pink, electric blue, acid green, white.
environments.audio_mood: Pulsing synthwave bass, retro wave arpeggios, distant city hum, rain on metal, engine reverb through tunnels.

sub_areas.name: Downtown Circuit
sub_areas.description: Beginner-friendly flat track through neon-lit streets. Wide turns, few obstacles.

sub_areas.name: Skyline Run
sub_areas.description: Rooftop track with gaps and ramps between buildings. Falling off = respawn at last checkpoint.

sub_areas.name: Undercity Tunnels
sub_areas.description: Underground track with tight turns, oncoming traffic, and shortcut pipes.

ambiance.lighting: Neon glow, volumetric light beams, bloom
ambiance.fog: Rain mist, light fog in tunnels
ambiance.sky: Dark purple with neon reflections on clouds

environments.name: Crystal Islands
environments.visual_description: Floating islands of crystalline rock suspended in an endless blue sky. Tracks loop around island edges, jump between floating platforms, and spiral through crystal caves. Waterfalls pour off edges into nothingness. Color palette: sky blue, crystal white, soft gold, cloud grey.
environments.audio_mood: Uplifting electronic melodies, wind rushing, crystal chimes on near-misses, gentle whoosh of open air.

sub_areas.name: Cloud Pier
sub_areas.description: Open-air track with massive jumps between islands. Gliding sections.

sub_areas.name: Crystal Caverns
sub_areas.description: Inside the islands — tight crystal tunnels with prismatic light.

sub_areas.name: The Edge
sub_areas.description: Track on the very edge of floating islands. No guard rails. High risk, high reward shortcuts.

ambiance.particles: Cloud wisps, crystal dust, wind streaks
ambiance.sky: Endless blue with scattered island shadows

environments.name: Magma Core
environments.visual_description: Deep underground volcanic track system. Rivers of lava illuminate cavern walls. Tracks are carved from obsidian with lava-fall jumps and heat-haze distortion. The air glows orange-red. Color palette: deep red, orange, obsidian black, molten gold.
environments.audio_mood: Heavy industrial beats, rumbling bass, lava bubbling, metal grinding on rails, dramatic synth stabs.

sub_areas.name: Obsidian Speedway
sub_areas.description: Long straightaways on cooled lava with lava-fall shortcuts.

sub_areas.name: Magma Tubes
sub_areas.description: Circular tunnel tracks that loop through active magma chambers.

sub_areas.name: The Crucible
sub_areas.description: Final championship track. Combines all mechanics at maximum speed.

procedural_generation.description: Infinite procedural track generation. Select environment, difficulty, and length. Share track seeds with friends. Daily challenge tracks for global leaderboards.

player.visual_description: Rider on a hover-bike. Rider is customizable with helmets, suits, and trail effects. Bike is customizable with body, engine, wheels, and color scheme.

abilities.name: Drift
abilities.description: Enter drift mode around corners. Builds boost meter.

abilities.name: Boost
abilities.description: Release stored boost energy for a speed burst.

abilities.name: Air Spin
abilities.description: Rotate in air for style points and small speed bonus on landing.

categories.name: Bike Parts

categories.name: Rider Gear
categories.description: Cosmetic gear for the rider character.

textures.name: Neon Glow Surface
textures.description: Self-illuminating surface with hot pink/blue neon glow. Bloom-enabled.

textures.name: Rain-slicked Road
textures.description: Wet asphalt reflecting neon lights. Puddle reflections.

animations.name: Drift Slide
animations.description: Bike tilts hard into a drift — sparks fly from wheels, tire smoke trails.

animations.name: Boost Burst

sfx.name: Drift Screech
sfx.description: Tire screech with metallic scrape and spark crackle.

sfx.name: Boost Ignition
sfx.description: Whoosh-BOOM jet engine ignition with bass drop.

ambient.name: City Night
ambient.description: Distant traffic, neon hum, rain patter, occasional siren.

vfx.name: Drift Sparks
vfx.description: Bright sparks showering from bike wheels during drift. Color matches bike trail.

vfx.name: Boost Flame
vfx.description: Blue-white exhaust flame expanding during boost. Heat distortion behind.

quests.name: First Ride
quests.description: Learn the basics of drifting, boosting, and track navigation.

quests.name: Speed Demon

world_events.name: Daily Challenge Track
world_events.description: A new procedural track every day. Global leaderboard. Top 10% earn bonus coins.

ui.style: Clean retro-futuristic. Pixel art UI elements with smooth animations. Neon accent borders.

hud_elements.name: Boost Meter
